The '''George Pólya Award''' is presented annually by the [[Mathematical Association of America]] (MAA) for articles of expository excellence that have been published in the [[College Mathematics Journal]].  The award was established in 1976, and up to two awards of $1,000 each are given each year.<ref name=maa>{{Cite web|url = https://maa.org/george-polya-awards/ |title = George Pólya Awards {{!}} Mathematical Association of America|website = www.maa.org}}</ref><ref>An exception was made in 1983 when three awards were given.</ref> The award is named after Hungarian mathematician [[George Pólya]].
